item: The test and Core-only jobs' end-of-job step also prints the ten slowest test modules by summed junit seconds, and a test fails on a Linux CI runner that lacks node, bash, git, unzip or a C compiler
summary: Observation only, no gate (R350). Timing: per module the sum of its testcases' junit time in whole seconds (setup + call + teardown, not wall time: 1.61 s summed in a 2.68 s process in the measurement; a session fixture's teardown lands on the run's last test), ten largest and the rest summed, a time that is not a plain decimal counted in one line and added to nothing; the step is renamed 'Skipped tests and slowest modules'. Tools: 54 test files skip on node (99 tests skip with no node on PATH, 590 pass, 1 fails: it calls node without a probe), plus bash 5 files, git 3, unzip 1, a C compiler 1, all provided by the ubuntu-latest image and asserted by nothing; one parametrized test is red on a Linux CI runner without them, the lists are checked in both directions against every shutil.which literal in tests/, and the same test run with no node on PATH is red end to end (green with one). Opus read: no BLOCK, its SHOULDs folded. Mutants killed: 13 of 13 on the timing block, 14 of 14 on the tool test (the sets the author ran; two survived the first read and got their own tests).
